data.command: Check if there are any unrecognized cron jobs in /etc/cron.d/ directories

data.text:
webapp@web-srv-01:~$ ls -la /etc/cron.d/
total 28
drwxr-xr-x   2 root root 4096 Jan 18 09:14 .
drwxr-xr-x 104 root root 4096 Feb  3 11:02 ..
-rw-r--r--   1 root root  102 Mar 31  2023 .placeholder
-rw-r--r--   1 root root  201 Nov 14 08:31 e2scrub_all
-rw-r--r--   1 root root  191 Feb  2 22:10 sysstat
-rw-r--r--   1 root root  396 Jan 18 09:14 webapp-backup
webapp@web-srv-01:~$ for f in /etc/cron.d/; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; echo; done
===== /etc/cron.d/.placeholder =====

===== /etc/cron.d/e2scrub_all =====
# e2scrub_all
30 3   0 root test -e /run/systemd/system || SERVICE_MODE=1 /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/e2fsprogs/e2scrub_all_cron

===== /etc/cron.d/sysstat =====
# /etc/cron.d/sysstat
# Run system activity accounting tool every 10 minutes
/10     root /usr/lib/sysstat/debian-sa1 1 1
# Rotate sa files every day
53 23    root /usr/lib/sysstat/sa1 1 1
# Generate the daily summary
5 0    root /usr/lib/sysstat/sa2 -A

===== /etc/cron.d/webapp-backup =====
SHELL=/bin/bash
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/sbin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin
MAILTO=ops@corp.local
# nightly webapp content + config backup
15 2   * root /opt/webapp/bin/backup.sh >> /var/log/webapp/backup.log 2>&1

webapp@web-srv-01:~$
